term: event tokens, subjects, respects, exercise and attained actuality
definition: Staged onset exercise attained bearer respect Potency Actual requires onset e < exercise e, exercise e ≤ attained e, the bearer potential in its event respect at onset, and actual in that respect at attainment. Event, Being, Respect and Time are distinct type parameters; these are supplied predicates and maps, not hidden existence or philosophical assumptions. Staging does not constrain a cause token to finish before its effect exercises.
